The Excel tool and reference documents are available below. The workbook interface and the detailed guides are currently in German.

## Excel tool

Download the current workbook from the [PEExcel GitHub repository](https://github.com/simonschaluppe/peexcel). Check the release or project notes for the applicable tool version before starting a project.

## Reference documents

- [PEQ assessment handbook (German)](../downloads/handbuch.pdf)
- [PEQ tool training presentation (German)](../downloads/schulung.pdf)
- [PEQ background guide (German)](../downloads/hintergrund.pdf)
- [PEQ standard overview (German)](../downloads/standard.pdf)
- [PEQ brochure (German)](../downloads/broschuere.pdf)

The workbook is macro-enabled and requires desktop Microsoft Excel / Office 365 for variant-management features.
